sourcedFrom: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture (2026)
cleanIntro: The CC9 is a short-recoil, Browning-type locked-breech 9 mm pistol with a rotating DISASSEMBLY LEVER on the left of the frame and AMBIDEXTROUS slide releases. Two things make its strip unlike the striker pistols it sits beside on the shelf. First, HK insists the strip run in a fixed order, because the order is what proves the gun empty before anything moves. Second, there is no conventional manual safety to fall back on — the pistol fires if the trigger is pulled with a round chambered, so the clearing procedure is the safety.

steps.title: ⛔ There is no manual safety on this pistol — clearing IS the safety
steps.action: Point the muzzle in a safe direction with your finger off the trigger and outside the trigger guard. Depress either side of the ambidextrous magazine release and remove the magazine from the well. Lock the slide back, then check the chamber and feed ramp BOTH by eye and with a finger. HK's own order is magazine first, then slide, then chamber, and the order is not decorative — a cartridge in the chamber will fire whether or not a magazine is in the gun.
steps.prose: Most owners coming from a hammer gun reach for a safety lever that this pistol does not have. Reach for the magazine instead.
steps.aside: To unload and clear your pistol, you MUST proceed in this order.
steps.quote: Your CC9 pistol does not have a conventional manual safety and it will fire if the trigger is pulled when there is a round in the chamber
steps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Safety features, printed p.10

steps.title: Eye protection on before anything is compressed
steps.action: Put safety glasses on before you start, and clear the bench of live ammunition. The recoil spring on this pistol comes out under its own load and goes back in compressed, which is the moment a part leaves at speed.
steps.prose: The spring does not care that the gun is empty.
steps.quote: Always wear safety glasses when disassembling your pistol to protect your eyes. Eye protection should, at a minimum, provide impact protection with side panels and meet ANSI standard Z87.1. Components, such as springs, are under pressure and could cause serious injury.
steps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Disassembly and assembly, printed p.20

steps.title: ⛔ Disassembly lever DOWN to six o'clock — slide still locked back
steps.action: With the slide still locked to the rear and the magazine out, rotate the disassembly lever on the left side of the frame downward until it points to roughly six o'clock. Do this with the slide locked back, not after you have released it — the lever turns freely in this state and fights you in any other.
steps.prose: If the lever will not reach six o'clock, the slide is not far enough back. Do not force it; re-lock the slide.
steps.caution: To ensure that your pistol is unloaded, disassembly MUST be performed in this order.
steps.quote: With the slide still locked to the rear and the magazine removed, rotate disassembly lever, located on the left-hand side of the frame assembly, downward until the lever is pointing to approximately the six o’clock position
steps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Disassembly, printed p.20

steps.title: Slide release down, slide FORWARD off the frame
steps.action: Depress the slide release and push the slide forward off the front of the frame assembly. It comes off the muzzle end, not the rear. Keep a hand over the slide as it runs off the rails — the recoil spring is still captive under the barrel at this point and the assembly is spring-loaded.
steps.prose: The slide leaving forward is the tell that this is a Browning-type gun and not a striker pistol with a takedown notch.
steps.quote: Depress the slide release (1) and push the slide forward (2), removing the slide from the top of the frame assembly
steps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Disassembly, printed p.21

steps.title: Recoil spring FORWARD and UP, out of the slide
steps.action: Turn the slide upside down and push the recoil spring forward and then upward to separate it from the barrel and slide. Forward first, then up — lifting before you push forward binds the guide rod against its seat on the barrel locking lug.
steps.prose: Note which end of the spring sat forward. It goes back the same way and the manual says so explicitly during assembly.
steps.quote: Turn the slide upside down and carefully push the recoil spring forward and upward, separating the recoil spring from the barrel and slide
steps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Disassembly, printed p.21

steps.title: Barrel forward, then UP through the ejection port
steps.action: Pivot the barrel slightly forward and press upward on the barrel locking block through the ejection port. The barrel lifts out of the slide. The locking block is what held it, and pressing on it through the port is the only way to release it without levering on the barrel itself.
steps.prose: That is the field strip. Four parts: frame assembly, slide, recoil spring, barrel — the manual shows them together as the sub-assemblies of a disassembled CC9.
steps.quote: Pivot the barrel slightly forward and press upward on the barrel locking block through the ejection port, separating the barrel from the slide
steps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Disassembly, printed p.21

steps.title: Field strip complete — frame, slide, recoil spring, barrel
steps.action: You now have four sub-assemblies. That is as far as HK takes the operator for cleaning, and it is far enough to clean the gun properly. Do not drift the chassis pin or take the magazine apart as part of a routine clean; both are separate procedures in the book with their own warnings.
steps.prose: The chassis is the serialised part on this pistol — the manual is explicit that it is the component legally considered the firearm. Leave it alone.
steps.quote: The chassis contains the serial number and is the part of the CC9 pistol that is legally considered to be the firearm for purposes of the Gun Control Act. Removal of the chassis is not required for ordinary cleaning and maintenance.
steps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Removal of chassis from frame assembly, printed p.26

deepSteps.title: Major cleaning is a threshold, not a feeling
deepSteps.action: HK sets two intervals. Normal cleaning is after each firing or every twelve months, whichever comes first. Major cleaning is after 600 cartridges, or any time the pistol meets sand, dust, water — saltwater especially — or other visible contamination. Major cleaning is normal cleaning plus taking the magazine apart and rinsing parts in solution.
deepSteps.prose: 600 rounds is a number you can count. 'It looks dirty' is not.
deepSteps.quote: Major Cleaning - Often referred to as “detailed cleaning.” Performed after the firing of 600 cartridges or when the pistol is exposed to, or contaminated with: • Sand • Dust • Water (especially saltwater) • Other visible contaminants or foreign matter.
deepSteps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Cleaning intervals, printed p.32

deepSteps.title: Bore: chamber to muzzle, six passes minimum
deepSteps.action: Work the bronze brush from the chamber end toward the muzzle, at least six passes back and forth, then patch it dry. Brushing from the muzzle end drags fouling back across the crown, which is the surface that decides where the bullet goes.
deepSteps.prose: The crown is the last thing to touch the bullet. Treat it accordingly.
deepSteps.quote: Moisten a bronze bore brush with cleaning solution and scrub the bore from the chamber to the muzzle with at least six (6) passes, back and forth.
deepSteps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Normal cleaning, printed p.32

deepSteps.title: Inspect for what HK lists, with the pistol CLEAR
deepSteps.action: Clear the pistol before inspecting. Look for damaged or missing parts, improper assembly, absence of free movement or spring force where there should be some, unaccustomed looseness, cracks, burrs or dents, missing stops or tactile clicks, corrosion, and whether there is enough lubricant.
deepSteps.prose: 'Unaccustomed looseness' is the useful one — it only means anything if you know what the gun felt like when it was right.
deepSteps.quote: It is essential that a function check be performed on the CC9 pistol after reassembly to ensure that the firearm’s components have been correctly installed.
deepSteps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Function check, printed p.24

deepSteps.title: ⛔ Lever DOWN and well EMPTY before the slide goes back on
deepSteps.action: Before mounting the slide, confirm no magazine is in the well and the disassembly lever is still down at six o'clock. Then seat the slide with the recoil spring centred under the barrel and the frame rails entered into the slide grooves.
deepSteps.prose: A lever left horizontal will let the slide start on and then stop it half way, and the temptation at that point is to push harder.
deepSteps.aside: Mount the slide onto the frame assembly, ensuring that the recoil spring is centered
deepSteps.quote: Ensure that no magazine is present in the magazine well and that the disassembly lever is in the down position (six o’clock).
deepSteps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Assembly, printed p.23

deepSteps.title: Prove the trigger resets before the gun goes away
deepSteps.action: After the slide is back and the lever horizontal, run the reset check: hold the trigger back, rack the slide, let it return to battery, then release the trigger and listen for the click. No click means the trigger group is not back the way it was.
deepSteps.prose: A reset you cannot hear is a reset you should not trust.
deepSteps.quote: Rack the slide to the rear and release, again keeping constant pressure on the trigger until the slide returns to battery. Release the trigger and listen for an audible click, signifying the trigger has reset.
deepSteps.cite: HK CC9 SERIES — OPERATOR'S MANUAL — 5.7.2026 FINAL — read from the document's own filename and page furniture — Function check, printed p.24

cleaning.name: BARREL AND BORE
tasks: Moisten a bronze 9 mm bore brush with cleaning solution and scrub the bore from CHAMBER to MUZZLE, at least six passes back and forth.
Push clean patches through until they come out clean; do not reverse a dirty patch back down the bore.
Scrub the outside of the barrel and the locking block with a nylon toothbrush — the locking block is where fouling collects on this design.

cleaning.name: SLIDE
tasks: Scrub all internal surfaces of the slide with a nylon toothbrush moistened with cleaning solution.
Remove loose fouling with a rag and cotton swabs, paying attention to the breech face and the grooves the frame rails run in.

cleaning.name: RECOIL SPRING ASSEMBLY
tasks: Remove all visible fouling with cleaning solution and a nylon toothbrush, a rag or cotton swabs.
Inspect for cracks, burrs or a loss of spring force before it goes back.

reassembly: ⛔ Barrel goes in FIRST, angular locking surface facing UPWARDS, slide upside down.
Pivot the barrel rearward until the locking block SNAPS into the slide ejection port.
Insert the LARGE end of the recoil spring into the tang on the slide above the muzzle.
Push the spring forward to compress it, then pivot the guide rod onto the stepped surface on the front of the barrel locking lug. Front of the spring faces FORWARD.
⛔ Disassembly lever must be DOWN at six o'clock and no magazine in the well before the slide goes on.

Slide onto the frame with the recoil spring centred under the barrel and the frame rails in the slide grooves; run it back, lock it, then pivot the disassembly lever COUNTERCLOCKWISE to horizontal and release the slide.
fncheck: HK treats the function check as essential after reassembly, not optional. Clear the pistol again first. Rack the slide three or four times in quick succession, fingers off the trigger — it should run without binding. With the gun EMPTY and pointed safely, pull the trigger for an audible click. Then rack the slide while holding the trigger back, let it return to battery, release the trigger and listen for the reset click. Finally, insert an EMPTY magazine and rack: the slide should lock back.
